components.css: .ds-ledger { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; max-width: 640px; } .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); color: var(--text-subtle, #71717a); transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ledger-row[data-state="done"] { color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); } .ds-ledger-row[data-state="active"] { color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); font-weight: 500; } .ds-ledger-row[data-state="failed"] { color: var(--danger, #b42318); font-weight: 500; } .ds-ledger-icon { display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-ledger-row[data-state="done"] .ds-ledger-icon { color: var(--success, #067647); } .ds-ledger-value { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-subtle, #71717a); } .ds-ledger-row[data-state="active"] .ds-ledger-value { color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); } .ds-spin { animation: ds-spin 900ms linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-spin { animation-duration: 2.4s; } }

narrative.overview:
RepoLens looks like a measuring tool laid on a white bench: black ink on white paper, hairline rules, and nothing that does not report something real. One narrow left-aligned column (640px of content) carries each screen; it starts well down the page so the single primary action sits in calm space rather than under a hero. The world is pinned by `docs/repolens-ui-ux-spec.md` §8 and shipped in light only; there is no dark theme and no theme toggle by project rule.

Two voices share the page. Inter speaks in sentences (headlines, explanations, labels). JetBrains Mono speaks in facts: every repository name, commit SHA, path, URL and number. A reader can tell at a glance which text is prose and which text is data copied from the analysis. Colour is withheld until state demands it: green appears only when something finished, red only when something failed, amber only when something is slow.

Depth comes from 1px rules and a one-step tonal shift, never from shadow. The signature pattern is the stage ledger: a ruled vertical list of the backend's real stages with a tabular mono column on the right that carries a number only where the backend reports real progress.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, black primary, zinc neutrals; semantic colour only for state.
Inter for prose, JetBrains Mono for every fact and number.
Flat: 1px rules and tonal panels, no shadows.
One narrow column, one primary action per screen.
Authored 16px line icons at a single 1.5 stroke.

rules.name: The Ink Is The Accent Rule
rules.body: Black is the only emphasis colour. There is no brand hue; a new surface that wants attention uses Ink, weight, or position, never a new colour.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber appear only to report job or input state, and always beside an icon or word that says the same thing; colour is never the only carrier of meaning.

rules.name: The Facts Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Every repository name, commit SHA, URL, path and progress number is set in JetBrains Mono; prose never is. Numbers that change in place use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Fourteen Base Rule
rules.body: The working size is 14px. Only the page headline (28px) and the repo title (20px) rise above 16px.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Shell screens are one narrow column with one primary action. No side rails, no card grids, no sidebar items for features that do not exist.

rules.name: The Rule Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px line or a one-step tonal shift. If a surface seems to need a shadow, give it a Hairline border instead.

dos: Do set every repository name, SHA, URL, path and number in JetBrains Mono, with tabular figures where it updates in place.
Do keep one Ink primary button per screen; secondary actions use the Paper button with a Strong Hairline border.
Do separate with 1px Hairline rules and the Paper-to-Bench-Grey tonal step.
Do pair every state colour with an icon or word saying the same thing.
Do use the authored 16px line icons (1.5 stroke, `currentColor`) and add new glyphs in the same grid and stroke.
Do animate only colour and background, 150ms on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and honour reduced motion.
Do show a number only where the backend reports real progress.
donts: Don't introduce a brand hue or use Done Green, Failed Red or Slow Amber for decoration.
Don't hardcode colours in components; every colour comes from a CSS variable on `:root`.
Don't add a dark theme or theme toggle; this build is light only.
Don't show placeholder data, fake progress bars, or navigation for features that do not exist.
Don't show "Safe", "All clear" or "0 issues" as a verdict.
